name: Gästehaus Rosemarie
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Rosemarie is an inviting inn in Tyrol, Austria. Situated in a peaceful setting surrounded by impressive mountains, the region is well-suited for hiking and winter sports. The rooms are traditionally furnished and equipped with modern comforts. An on-site restaurant serves flavourful regional cuisine. Amenities include a garden and dedicated parking spaces. Guests enjoy warm, friendly service and a truly relaxing alpine atmosphere.
